scientific_integrity: The infinite-family proof is self-contained; five exhaustive small cases provide corroboration. Full text of motivating 2026 source inaccessible; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only unfilled complete multipartite graphs with at least three parts each of size at least two; only canonical integral H0 symmetry module, not full H1 decomposition; no pure strong or ordinary Morse matching statement.
title: Component decomposition of full strong Morse complexes of complete multipartite graphs
